27/* @brief Parameters for a camera sensor (fixed or wrist-mounted).
28 * Loaded from a .superdex_sensor JSON file via SReflect.
29 * Fields with value 0 mean "use engine default". */
30struct SensorCameraParams {
31 DynamicString name;
32
33 int imageWidth = 0;
34 int imageHeight = 0;
35
36 real fovVerticalDeg = 0_r;
37 real nearClip = 0_r;
38 real farClip = 0_r;
39
40 /* Look-at target in world space (fixed cameras only). */
41 Real3 lookAt = {};
42
43 /* Offset from EE frame origin in local coordinates (wrist cameras only). */
44 Real3 offsetLocal = {};
45
46 /* Forward direction in EE-local frame (wrist cameras only). */
47 Real3 forwardAxis = {};
48
49 /* Up direction in EE-local frame (wrist cameras only). */
50 Real3 upAxisLocal = {};
51
52 /* Distance ahead of offset point to place look-at target (wrist cameras only). */
53 real lookDistance = 0_r;
54
55 /* @brief Load sensor parameters from a JSON file.
56 * @param path Path to a .superdex_sensor JSON file.
57 * @param error Error status.
58 * @return Loaded parameters. */
59
60 /* @brief Save sensor parameters to a JSON file.
61 * @param path Destination file path.
62 * @param error Error status. */
63
64 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::SensorCameraParams)
65 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
66 MOCHI_FIELD(imageWidth) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("px"));
67 MOCHI_FIELD(imageHeight) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("px"));
68 MOCHI_FIELD(fovVerticalDeg) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("deg"));
69 MOCHI_FIELD(nearClip) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
70 MOCHI_FIELD(farClip) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
71 MOCHI_FIELD(lookAt) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
72 MOCHI_FIELD(offsetLocal) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
73 MOCHI_FIELD(forwardAxis)
74 MOCHI_FIELD(upAxisLocal)
75 MOCHI_FIELD(lookDistance) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
76 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
77};

79/* @brief Camera sensor runtime object.
80 * Stores intrinsics/extrinsics for use by renderers (UE, etc.).
81 * No ComputeSignal — cameras don't produce data in the mochi physics loop;
82 * renderers query GetParams() to configure their camera actors. */
83// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
84class MOCHI_API SensorCamera : public SensorBase {
85 public:
86 /* @brief Registration type name for this sensor (see RoboticsContext::RegisterSensorType).
87 * @return This sensor's registration type name. */
88 static constexpr std::string_view TypeName() {
89 return "SENSOR_CAMERA";
90 }
91
92 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GetTypeName() const override {
93 return TypeName();
94 }
95
96 SensorStepResult Step(StepTime const& /*now*/, superdex::Error& /*error*/) override {
97 return SensorStepResult::NoUpdate;
98 }
99
100 using Params = SensorCameraParams;
101
102 /* @brief Construct from @p paramArgs -- either a params file path or an inline JSON string (empty
103 * uses defaults); the sensor loads its own params. This is the factory
104 * RoboticsContext::RegisterSensor uses. */
105 SensorCamera(Actor* linkActor, std::string_view paramArgs, superdex::Error& error);
106
107 /* @brief Construct from a pre-loaded params struct (programmatic / non-filesystem construction).
108 */
109 SensorCamera(Actor* linkActor, Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
110
111 /* @brief Get sensor parameters.
112 * @return The params. */
113 [[nodiscard]] Params const& GetParams() const {
114 return _params;
115 }
116
117 /* @brief Set sensor parameters.
118 * @param params Params.
119 * @param error Error status. */
120 void SetParams(Params const& params, [[maybe_unused]] superdex::Error& error) {
121 _params = params;
122 }
123
124 private:
125 void ResetSensor() override {
126 /* A camera holds only its parameters and pose between samples. */
127 }
128
129 SensorFormat InitSensor(SensorScope const& /*scope*/, superdex::Error& error) override {
130 MOCHI_ERROR_SET(error, "SensorCamera is not yet graph-enabled");
131 return {};
132 }
133
134 Params _params;
135};
